# Naming fixtures Kivo parses differently, one per line:
# source<TAB>name<TAB>reason. TestFixtures fails on a failure missing here
# and on a line here that passes, so the list stays exact.
#
# Pass rate: 797 of 1014 (78.6%); the test logs the current figure.
#
# What the fixtures are checked on (fixtures_test.go):
# - Only fields a Guess models: title, year, season, episodes, and for
#   anitomy also group, checksum, revision, specials and split letters.
#   Codecs, sources, languages, anitomy's type, volume and part are ignored.
# - Titles compare as Key with spaces removed, since the fixtures disagree
#   on punctuation and case.
# - A guessit fixture with no type and no season or episode passes if either
#   a movies or a shows library parses it: a real library declares its kind.
# - anitomy's group is checked only when the name starts with [Group];
#   identification doesn't use groups, and trailing ones read as titles.
# - anitomy lists a range by its ends ("13", "15"), so only the ends compare.
#
# Most entries fall into a few groups: season packs (Kivo parses single
# files), names with '/' (a path separator to Parse), non-English season
# and episode words, and anime OP/ED/volume/cour tokens. The fixtures are
# torrent release names, which are messier than library file names.
